proof_scope: deterministic JSONL capture, live Memory structured/store read-back, searchable Memory recall, strict $shame self-correction checking, and one-word Chatterbox shame audio install

claims.proves: the shame CLI captures assistant text, prior user text, labels, hashes, JSONL rows, legacy label mappings, live Memory write/read-back records, searchable Memory recall records for classifier training, strict $shame self-correction rejection of answers without a Status Report footer or with unacted obvious next steps, and one short Chatterbox shame-word audio install with no bell/loop
claims.does_not_prove: classifier training quality, automatic transcript discovery in every Pi session shape, future model promotion, or that every already-running Pi TUI has reloaded the updated extension

capability_claims.description: Capture a labeled assistant response as reusable classifier training data.
Persist shame examples to the Memory daemon and independently read them back.
Persist a searchable shadow document so $memory recall can find related shame examples by BM25 and semantic score.
Install one short Chatterbox shame word without a bell or repeated loop.
$shame self-correction mode rejects terse or meta answers unless they end with a plain Status Report footer.

cases.name: local-jsonl-capture-contract
command: cd .. && session=$(mktemp) && out=$(mktemp) && printf '%s\n' '{"type":"message","id":"u1","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"what is your actual status"}]}}' '{"type":"message","id":"a1","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Committed and pushed. Done."}]}}' > $session && ./run.sh capture --session $session --entry-id a1 --out $out --verdict reject --reason commit_laundering --note 'missing actual status' --no-memory >/tmp/shame_local_eval_receipt.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const row=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').trim()); if(row.human_verdict!=='reject') throw new Error('bad verdict'); if(!row.human_reasons.includes('commit_laundering')) throw new Error('bad reason'); if(row.classifier_label!=='bullshit_update') throw new Error('bad classifier'); if(!row.user_text.includes('actual status')) throw new Error('missing user text'); console.log('LOCAL_JSONL_CAPTURE_OK')" $out

cases.name: legacy-label-no-memory-contract
command: cd .. && out=$(mktemp) && ./run.sh capture --text 'Committed and pushed.' --label commit_laundering --no-memory --out $out | tee /tmp/shame_legacy_eval.out && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const row=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8').trim()); if(row.human_verdict!=='reject') throw new Error('bad verdict'); if(!row.human_reasons.includes('commit_laundering')) throw new Error('bad reason'); console.log('LEGACY_LABEL_OK')" $out

cases.name: live-memory-store-readback-and-recall
command: cd .. && out=$(mktemp) && receipt=$(./run.sh capture --text 'Committed and pushed.' --verdict reject --reason vague_git_update --reason synthetic_fixture --note 'agentic eval live memory write' --out $out --memory-collection shame_training_examples --search-collection project_knowledge) && printf '%s\n' "$receipt" > /tmp/shame_live_memory_receipt.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/shame_live_memory_receipt.json','utf8')); if(!d.ok) throw new Error('not ok'); if(d.memory.collection!=='shame_training_examples') throw new Error('wrong collection'); if(d.memory.read_back_count!==1) throw new Error('no structured readback'); if(d.memory.search_collection!=='project_knowledge') throw new Error('wrong search collection'); if(d.memory.search_read_back_count!==1) throw new Error('no search readback'); if(d.memory.recall_found!==true) throw new Error('not recallable'); console.log('LIVE_MEMORY_READBACK_RECALL_OK')"

cases.name: strict-shame-self-correction-footer-required
command:
cd .. && REPORT_CHECK=${LAZY_REPORT_SHAME_REPORT_CHECK:-/home/graham/.pi/agent/extensions/lazy-report-shame-shame-shame/report-check.mjs} && if printf 'Recorded.
' | LRSSS_STRICT_STATUS=1 node $REPORT_CHECK >/tmp/shame_strict_bad.json 2>/tmp/shame_strict_bad.err; then echo 'strict checker accepted terse answer' >&2; exit 1; fi && printf 'Corrected.

Status Report
- Changed: Answer is now plain.
- Verified: Not verified: no command was run.
- Proof: Missing: no artifact exists.
- Not done: none.
' | LRSSS_STRICT_STATUS=1 node $REPORT_CHECK >/tmp/shame_strict_good.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/shame_strict_bad.json','utf8'));const good=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/shame_strict_good.json','utf8')); if(bad.decision!=='reject') throw new Error('bad did not reject'); if(!bad.footer_failures.includes('missing_trailing_report_title')) throw new Error('missing footer failure'); if(good.decision!=='pass') throw new Error('good did not pass'); console.log('STRICT_SHAME_SELF_CORRECT_OK')"

cases.name: strict-obvious-next-step-not-enacted-rejected
command:
cd .. && REPORT_CHECK=${LAZY_REPORT_SHAME_REPORT_CHECK:-/home/graham/.pi/agent/extensions/lazy-report-shame-shame-shame/report-check.mjs} && if printf 'Done.

Status Report
- Changed: Added the feature.
- Verified: Not verified: agentic-evals were not run.
- Proof: Missing: no receipt.
- Not done: run agentic-evals next.
' | LRSSS_STRICT_STATUS=1 node $REPORT_CHECK >/tmp/shame_obvious_next_step_bad.json 2>/tmp/shame_obvious_next_step_bad.err; then echo 'strict checker accepted unacted obvious next step' >&2; exit 1; fi && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/shame_obvious_next_step_bad.json','utf8')); if(d.decision!=='reject') throw new Error('did not reject'); if(!d.footer_failures.includes('obvious_next_step_not_enacted')) throw new Error('missing obvious-next-step failure'); console.log('OBVIOUS_NEXT_STEP_REJECT_OK')"

cases.name: one-word-chatterbox-audio-install
command: cd .. && dir=$(mktemp -d) && ./run.sh audio install --source /tmp/lrsss-chatterbox-lower-female-shame-single.wav --extension-dir $dir >/tmp/shame_audio_eval_receipt.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/shame_audio_eval_receipt.json','utf8')); if(!d.ok) throw new Error('not ok'); if(d.installed.duration_sec>2.5) throw new Error('too long'); if(d.installed.sha256!=='a3596aff349c98732f3c2c4b797a451fcf6a858d138c0b497d5df3642a5497dc') throw new Error('wrong audio'); console.log('ONE_WORD_AUDIO_OK')"
